newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Kirkcaldies ups first half profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Kirkcaldies ups first half profit.

text.p: WELLINGTON, April 15 - Up-market Wellington department store Kirkcaldie and Stains on Monday announced a small lift in first-half profit and said it hoped full-year profit would exceed last year's result of NZ$2.23 million.

The company said despite difficult trading conditions, net profit rose 8.1 percent to NZ$1.24 million for the six months to February 28, compared with $1.144 million for the six months to the end of February 1996.
Sales increased by 2.8 percent to $16.267 million from $15.832 million in the previous corresponding period while earnings per share rose to 24.73c from 22.88c previously.
Chairman Denis Tait said the company's directors considered the results positive under the circumstances.
But Tait said despite the improved trading in the first months of 1997, the outlook for overall retail sales was for them to remain stagnant through the rest of 1997.
